course_name_original: EXPRESION GRAFICA Y DISEÑO ASISTIDO POR ORDENADOR (565000315)

learning_outcomes.text: Capacity for spatial vision and knowledge of graphic representation techniques, both by traditional methods of metric and descriptive geometry, and by computer-aided design applications; fundamentals of industrial design.
Communicate knowledge and conclusions, both orally and in writing, to specialized and non-specialized audiences clearly and unambiguously.
Possess the learning skills that allow continuous lifelong study for adequate professional development.
Incorporate ICT and Industrial Engineering technologies and tools into their professional activities.
Know and apply basic science and technology knowledge to the practice of Industrial Engineering.
Ability to know, understand and use the principles of representation techniques, spatial conception, standardization, computer-aided design, fundamentals of industrial design.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of CAD applied to Graphic Expression
Introduction to Computer-Aided Design. Model Space and Paper Space. Template
Drawing Aids. Object Snaps. Drawing. Editing. Annotations. Clipboard. Point Filters.
Detachable joints. Threaded elements. Conical elements
assessment_rules: The final grade is the arithmetic mean of the Spatial Conception grade and the Normalization grade. Both Spatial Conception and Normalization grades must be equal to or greater than 4 out of 10 to be averaged. The subject is passed if the final grade is equal to or greater than 5 out of 10. Students who do not pass via progressive evaluation can take a global exam in the ordinary or extraordinary call. If one part is passed, students can retake only the failed part in the global exam, provided the retake grade is 4 or higher.
